name: 'Al'

tenures.role: valet — Moran Clan; briefly Grizzly Beer Champion in his own right
tenures.note: Sirus's own bio card: a birthday gift from his uncle Mack, lost for a time and found again in an attic trunk; "if he has any title belts at the time, he always wears at least one of them... 'Al' is always with him." The Grizzly Beer Title ledger even credits 'Al' a brief reign in his own right (10 March 2001, over Ty Copas and Sirus, "when President Robinson cheated"). "Wednesday Night Chaos" opens on his absence ("They just aren't the same without... 'Al'"); the Tag Team and World Title ledgers separately record him traded away and fought over more than once.
